disputes.reason: The 2026-08-25 rule is realpath-inside-the-effort (traversal). A /report/<other_pid>/… URL is not traversal; it is a first-class, already token-gated app route. Calling pid-scope 'the route-world analog' is analogical transfer, which RC-1 forbids, and no independent record names cross-project register links as a hazard. The HTTP layer already 404s unknown pids. Parser-as-text is RC-G theater whose false alarm is real: a hand-written related-project citation goes dead.

Parsing run: from the existing Where cell is independently forced. Scanning an optional 5th How column is a schema change the locked North Star parked ('beyond an optional cell'). That extra column inherits nothing from the runnable-code quote (RC-1 packaging).
disputes.trigger: Keep run: in the Where cell only; do not add or parse a 5th column unless John ratifies a schema change.

The v2–v12 CLI-mirror law is an R&D anchor.py rnd convention. The steward register is not that seam and is already inspectable via /api/steward/deliverables and register-all. Their own rc2 admits nothing user-facing breaks. Analogical application of an R&D convention is RC-1; the North Star does not fail (RC-6).

Registering every session_doc_roles/persisted doc (agent, provenance, …) is a fan-out the 2026-09-05 quote does not force and dumps computer-facing files onto the human register (RC-4). The finish_run hook is independently needed; the per-doc blast is not.
